punchline: At a Chicago-area high school, struggling readers who worked out before class gained more reading level than those who exercised later in the day.
thirty_sec: Naperville Central's zero-hour PE class started in 2004 with heart-rate monitors and a literacy program; the school's own numbers favored students whose reading class followed the workout, though the groups were tiny.
question: Which task needs your sharpest attention this week, and what could you do for ten minutes right before it?
key_contrast: A reading class right after the workout versus one scheduled last thing in the day.
